changes: Notes refined: '-yati' is probably 'iti' ('Sarvānanda iti lekhakaḥ'), followed by a garbled form of the usual 'lekhako doṣo nāsti' formula; 'vasite' is unclear

persons.name: Sarvānanda
persons.evidence: likhite ʼyaṃ vasite śrī vajrācāryyasarvvānando-yati lekhako

notes: The colophon is corrupt. 'likhite ʼyaṃ vasite śrī vajrācāryyasarvvānando-yati lekhako doṣa(!) nāsti' most likely means 'likhitam idaṃ ... śrīvajrācāryasarvānanda iti lekhakaḥ; lekhako doṣo nāsti'. 'vasite' is unclear: it could be a corrupt verb, or less likely a place name, so no place is recorded. There is no date. The scribe agrees with the catalogue field.
